_about: Layout rules of the video-only screens, in 1920x1080 design px. The one source: py promo/layout_build.py writes layout.data.js from this file, layout.js turns it into CSS variables and coordinates. Values were read from the pages as they were on 2026-11-03.

band._note: subtitle band: y >= 910 (the bottom 170 px) holds nothing but the subtitles

min_text._note: smallest font size (design px = px at 1080p). A rule of this project, not taken from an outside standard. The smallest text now is the N08b sources, 21 px Japanese.

grid._note: tiles fly in from fly_from; the grid spans margin.side to 1920 - margin.side

fig._note: two figures, centred on the screen's middle with gap between them

bars._note: both bars share one scale: 100 % = 800 px

url._note:
until 2026-11-03 the CSS said top 826 and the

kept its 1em top margin (30 px), so the line sat at 856; now margin 0 and top 856, same picture

band_exempt.why: authoring clock, drawn in the band with ?guides=1

allow_overflow.why: line-height (1 to 1.3) is shorter than the font's content box (ascent + descent), so scrollHeight runs a few px past the line box. Measured 2-7 px (0.06-0.23 em). The glyphs stay inside and no ancestor clips them; a taller line-height would move the text

allow_overlap.why: the vehicle is drawn over the vertical light on purpose
